source: EXAMPLE ONLY. The real file is db/seed/directory.json, which is gitignored.
note: Copy this to directory.json and replace it with the district's list. Real names and
mobile numbers never go in the repository: git history is permanent, and a private repo
can be shared, forked or gain a collaborator later. The same rule as .env.
One row per post. `department` is the office verbatim; the loader does not infer that
'ADC (General)' sits under the DC Office, because how Bajaur is organised is a fact to be
A row with no `name` or no `phone` loads as a VACANT post. That is a real state, not a
broken row — escalation and notification both surface a vacant seat rather than skipping
`tier` defaults to 'district' when absent. It drives the escalation ladder, so a
directory that leaves it out will not escalate correctly. See Q-18.
